page.notes: The scan is cut off at the foot, so the paragraph "NOs, ut decuit..." continues on the next part. The word "disseruimus" is doubtful: the letters look like "differuimus" and I have read the long s as ss. The initial N is a large woodcut letter, joined to the word.
